title: Slide Over
description: A detail and edit panel for one record in a Drawer, composing the @moderno-ui/{framework} Drawer, Button, Field and Alert primitives: a bordered panel with the person's name as a serif heading, their email, an "Edit details" Button and a list of their role and notes ("Not added" when empty); the Button opens a Drawer from the right holding name, email, role and notes fields filled from the record, with Cancel and "Save changes"; the form refuses an empty name or email, marks those fields invalid and focuses the first, and has its own loading and error renders; `open` can be bound so the consumer closes the Drawer once a save succeeds; responds to its container (@container) — the trigger stops filling its row and each term sits beside its value at @sm, the heading steps up at @md, and the trigger sits beside the name with more room above and below at @lg.
